Elena — thanks for the files and for the clear summary. Incoming ticket for procurement intake is opened (HS-48732). A few quick clarifications from Redwood's side so we can hand this to Finance for PO setup: 

What we need from you (action items):
1) Full bank routing + account number in a secure channel (we prefer an encrypted PDF or a short bank-details-stub file uploaded to the Drive link below).
2) Billing contact name, email, and phone for the PO header.
3) Remit-to address for invoices and whether you accept ACH and wire.
4) Confirmation on whether SummitEdge requires a vendor master >30 day payment terms (standard Redwood is Net 30).
5) Any required vendor insurance certificate or SOC2 attestation (if applicable).

Notes on our side / what you can expect from Redwood: 
- Procurement will validate W-9 and bank info, then create a vendor record in our AP system.
- Once the vendor record is live, Finance issues an initial PO (we can do a one-off test PO if you prefer).
- Standard processing time after receipt of all items is 5–7 business days. If you need an expedited PO, please state it and we'll escalate.

Secure upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcExampleOnboardingDocs (please place bank details in the folder and mark the file "CONFIDENTIAL")
